theme_and_archetype.reasoning: PericL is a personal mirror, not a tech assistant. It needs to feel intimate, calm, and grounded. The aesthetic must rely on natural textures, warm neutrals, and organic shapes rather than tech-bro or neon AI signals.

headings.family: Cormorant Garamond, serif (or a similar high-contrast classic serif)
headings.usage: Use for the Hero H1, Feature Wall section titles, and major conceptual statements.

body.usage: Use for chat bubbles, descriptions, FAQ answers, and UI elements.

color_strategy.background: Use existing theme variables (bg-background). For highlighted sections or alternating blocks, use bg-secondary/30 or soft tinted surfaces.
color_strategy.primary: Use existing hsl(var(--primary)). Ensure it feels like a subtle accent (e.g., in the 'Next Move' target icon or active states) rather than a loud dominant color.
color_strategy.chat_bubbles: Rely on existing .bubble-mine and .bubble-them classes, but ensure they sit on a neutral or deeply calm background. Use subtle shadow-sm for depth.
color_strategy.accents: Avoid stark black or pure white borders. Use border-border/50 or border-primary/10 for delicate separations.

layout_and_spacing.general: Embrace generous padding (p-12 to p-32). Do not center everything; use asymmetric, left-aligned typography to create an editorial, documentary feel.
layout_and_spacing.hero: Asymmetric bento or split grid. Left column: massive, confident serif typography + Google Auth button. Right column: The 'Mirror' interactive chat mockup, floating gracefully.
layout_and_spacing.feature_wall: Use a 2x2 or 3-col grid with generous gaps (gap-12 or gap-16). No hard 'cards'; go cardless or use extremely subtle 1px border with large padding.
layout_and_spacing.privacy_block: Visually distinct block. Use an earthy/muted background, bold typography, and a massive Lock icon to convey physical ownership of data.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use framer-motion for staggered entrance animations. Elements should 'fade up' softly (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion_and_interactions.blobs: Keep the existing .blob CSS class active in the background for subtle organic movement.
motion_and_interactions.chat_demo: Stagger the entrance of the chat bubbles in the Hero to simulate a live response. First .bubble-mine appears, pause, then .bubble-them appears.

components_and_structure.nav: Minimal header with Logo (text), Theme Toggle (data-testid='login-theme-toggle'), and a secondary soft sign-in anchor.
components_and_structure.hero_section: Headline: 'Your inner voice, written down.' Subtitle: 'A personal journal that sorts your thoughts and reflects you back. No AI. Just you—clearer.' CTA: Google Login Button (data-testid='login-google-btn').
components_and_structure.show_dont_tell_section: A mockup of the Mirror interface. User: 'I'll start the launch tomorrow, today I'm too tired'. Mirror: 'You said launching matters. Pushing it off again is how nothing ships. 🎯 Next Move: open your draft and write 3 plain sentences for the launch tweet.'

features_clusters.capture: Speak or type. It automatically sorts into tasks, reminders, and ideas.
features_clusters.mirror: A chat that talks back as you—calmer, more honest.
features_clusters.track: Monitor up to 3 missions, track your mood, and review daily recaps in your own voice.
features_clusters.privacy: Stays on your device by default. Cloud sync is strictly opt-in.

components_and_structure.faq_section: Clean minimalist accordion or grid list. Q: 'Is this AI?' A: 'No. It's your own voice, written down.' Q: 'Where does my data live?' A: 'On your device, until you say otherwise.'
components_and_structure.footer: © Giridhar Alwar · PericL · Personal Voice Journal

hero_background.description: Abstract warm sand texture, use as an extremely low opacity (5-10%) background blend or mask to add organic texture to the page. Wrap in a div with pointer-events-none and absolute positioning.

privacy_illustration.description: Vintage lock to reinforce the physical, on-device privacy concept. Use creatively in the Privacy block.

media_and_assets.icons: Lucide React (e.g., Mic, Sparkles, Lock, Target, Shield, LineChart, MessageSquare)

anti_patterns_to_avoid.language: NEVER use the words 'AI assistant', 'chatbot', 'powered by', or 'magic'.
anti_patterns_to_avoid.visuals: No purple gradients, no generic tech vectors, no centered-everything layouts.

strict_preservations: Existing startLogin() handler for the Google button
instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign Login.jsx entirely using Tailwind CSS, framer-motion, and Lucide React. Implement the 'Show, Don't Tell' chat UI in the hero area to visually explain the app using the existing .bubble-mine and .bubble-them classes. Build clean, accessible markup. Ensure every interactive element has a kebab-case data-testid. Install framer-motion if not present. Use standard font-sans and font-serif but style them elegantly. Keep the vibe extremely calm, analog, and privacy-centric. Focus heavily on whitespace and typography.
